welcome.metaTitle: Codify — learn to code and actually finish
welcome.metaDescription: Bite-size lessons, real coding exercises, AI-graded practice and streaks that keep you coming back — in Portuguese and English.
welcome.heroBody: Bite-size lessons, real coding exercises, AI-graded practice, and a streak that keeps you coming back — in Portuguese and English.

exercises.title: Real exercises
exercises.body: Write code in the browser and get graded against hidden tests — instantly.

ai.title: AI-graded practice
ai.body: Free-text answers scored against a rubric, with feedback on what to improve.

scenarios.title: Branching scenarios
scenarios.body: Practice soft skills through interactive, replayable dialogue.

streaks.title: Streaks & leagues
streaks.body: XP, coins, streaks and weekly leagues keep momentum going.

welcome.proofBody: Finish a course and get a certificate with a public verification link anyone can check.

features.metaDescription: Lessons, coding exercises, AI-graded prompts, scenarios, streaks, leagues, offline learning and verifiable certificates.
features.title: Everything you need to keep learning
features.subtitle: Short lessons, real practice, and rewards that make the habit stick.

lessons.title: Bite-size lessons
lessons.body: Readings and quizzes designed for a few minutes a day.
points: Free preview lessons in every course

practice.title: Hands-on practice
practice.body: Learn by doing, not just reading.
points: Code exercises graded by visible and hidden tests
AI-graded prompts with a rubric that lights up

motivation.title: Built-in motivation
motivation.body: Small wins every day add up.
points: XP, coins, levels and daily quests
Streaks with freezes for busy days

offline.title: Learn offline
offline.body: Download a course and keep going on the bus or a plane.
points: Readings, quizzes and scenarios work offline
Progress syncs as soon as you are back online

certificates.title: Verifiable certificates
points: A certificate for every completed course
A public link anyone can verify
